title: Audit log
description: Who did what, and when: sign-ins, access changes and other administrative actions on the server.

empty.title: No audit events yet
empty.body: Events appear here as soon as something changes.

detail.subtitle: Audit event
detail.noDetails: This event has no additional details.
detail.notFound: The full event could not be loaded: it no longer exists or you may not read it. The values from the list are shown.

info.search: Matches part of the action, the target ID, the actor's name or the actor ID, ignoring case. Request IDs are not searched.
info.productAdmin: “All products” also includes installation-wide events that belong to no product, such as sign-ins.
info.productScoped: You see events of products where you may read the audit log (audit:read). Installation-wide events, such as sign-ins, need the platform permission platform:audit.
info.action: The exact action name, such as tenancy.tenant.create. End it with * to match every action that starts with it, such as tenancy.*.
info.range: In your local time. “From” includes that moment, “Until” does not.
info.outcome: Success: carried out. Denied: refused by the server, for example a wrong password. Failure: attempted but did not succeed.
info.requestId: Identifies the HTTP request that caused this event. Error messages and the server logs show the same ID.
